basic_info.description: Sophisticated living, peaceful and serene in the heart of San Francisco. Nestled near iconic landmarks; Coit Tower and The Filbert Steps, just a few blocks from the Financial District, world-class dining, the Ferry Building, and endless city adventures. 116 Alta Street transforms the concept of urban living into a home that has been thoughtfully remodeled and extensively updated. The expansive primary suite boasts a cozy fireplace, a comfortable seating area, a wall of built-in cabinets and shelving, plus office space. Indulge in the spa-like bathroom featuring a soaking tub, double sinks, and a separate water closet. For your convenience, the extra-large walk-in closet includes a full-size washer and dryer.  The upper level impresses with 10' ceilings and a spacious living/dining area adorned with a fireplace and generous natural light, complemented by downtown views. The light-filled kitchen is equipped with Bosch appliances and custom cabinets, opening up to a private yard. The second bedroom features pocket doors, allowing it to convert into a home office or gym. A custom full bathroom completes this level. What truly sets this home apart is the private roof deck, offering stunning views of downtown San Francisco. Garage leased parking +/- 500' on Union Stree
